court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Rohit M. Sanghvi And Ors vs Pankaj C. Gandhi And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: Dr. Pankaj Champaklal Gandhi & Anr., Defendants; Mrs Jyoti Pankaj Gandhi, Obstructionist

facts_of_case: Two Chamber Summonses concern the right of an obstructionist to a property attached in execution. The obstructionist is the wife of the original Defendant and judgment debtor.

legal_principles.principle: A deed of rectification and a deed of confirmation-cum-declaration can be executed to transfer property after the decree has been passed.
legal_principles.held: Though, by virtue of a deed of confirmation-cum-declaration and deed of rectification read with the agreement for sale, the HUF is the transferee of the suit flat and also a share holder of the society in respect of the same...

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to defeat the rights of a judgment debtor's creditors to prove that the transfer was not done with an intention to defraud.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted by learned counsel for the Plaintiff that these documents have been executed and transfer of the suit flat in the name of HUF has been obtained only with a view to defeat the rights of the Defendant's creditors including the Plaintiff...

outcome.final_order: The two chamber summonses involve essentially the right of the obstructionist to raise an obstruction to the attachment.
